parties:
Fazlur Rahman and others
Vs.
Anjab Khan being dead his heirs Haji Md. Manir Khan & Ors.
full_judgment: The predecessor of the opposite parties as plaintiff filed on 12.09.1973 title Suit No. 233 of 1973 (renumbered at Title Suit No. 8 of 1978) before the learned Sub-ordinate Judge, 2nd Court, Sylhet for declaration of Title in schedule-1 and confirmation of possession in respect of land described in Schedule-11 and for recovery of khas possession in respect of lands described in Schedule-111. The case of the plaintiff opposite parties in brief was that, the suit land originally belonged to Romesh Chandra Chowdhury amongst them Romesh Chandra Chowdhury died, leaving behind Ratish Chowdhury and Suresh Chandra Chowdhury died leaving behind only son Sankar Prasad Chowdhury, the proforma defendants No. 13 and 14 respectively. That the Proforma defendants Nos. 13 and 14 entered into an agreement for sale with the plaintiff for the suit land with a consideration of Tk. 15,000/- and executed a Bainapatra on 14.4.1969 in favour of the plaintiff on receipt of Tk. 13,000/- and delivered possession thereof and they agreed to execute the requisite kabala within three months on receipt of balance consideration, but on being refused the original plaintiff filed Title Suit No. 202 of 1969 for specific performance of Contract against the proforma defendant Nos. 13 and 14 and got decree on 26.01.70 and also the requisite kabala on 11.02.72 through court vide Title execution case No. 5 of 1970. That defendant Nos. 1-3, 9-12 and predecessor of defendant Nos. 4-8 created some false, fraud, fraudulent collusive and anti-dated documents by false personification, The aforesaid defendants wrongfully and forcefully dispossessed the plaintiffs on 06.9.1972 from the suit 3rd Schedule land and also threatened to dispossess from the suit 2nd schedule land and hence the suit.
